result.instructions: Tools for PaySpace, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who are the active employees in our company, and which department is each in?"; "Show the payslip lines for March 2026 and total the gross pay per employee."; "Which leave applications were submitted in October 2026?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PaySpace data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run payspace_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run payspace_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run payspace_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. payspace_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: payspace_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies (id, code, name, group) the API credentials can access. Company ids go into the company_id argument of the other tools. From the token reply of POST /connect/token.

tools.name: payspace_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List active employees of a company with their biographical details (name, employee number, contact, dates). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee. Use payspace_list_all_employees to include terminated employees.

company_id.description: PaySpace company id or company code. Optional when the credentials give access to exactly one company; call payspace_list_companies to see them.

skip.description: Records to skip ($skip), for paging: page 2 of size 100 is skip=100.

count.description: Include the total number of matching records as @odata.count.

filter.description: OData $filter, for example `EmployeeNumber eq 'E001'` or `contains(LastName,'Smith')`. Field names: see the vendor docs for the entity.

select.description: OData $select: comma-separated field names to return (smaller replies).
